verdict.rationale: Fenwick ships client-facing technology (a trademark extranet and AI tools), so a natural-language command interface is a fair question, but the evidence shows none. The AI tools work through document upload (a brief) or automated extraction, and the extranet is operated through tabs. Neither is natural-language command operation, and the probes found no llms.txt or API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
